name: ci-cd-and-automation
tagline_zh: 还在手写YAML？让Agent帮你搭CI/CD，自动设质量门禁、测试跑法、部署策略，改一行配置，全流程跟着变。
tagline_en: Stop hand-writing YAML. Agent sets up CI/CD, quality gates, test runners, deploy strategies—change one line.
desc_en: Automates CI/CD pipeline setup. Use when setting up or modifying build and deployment pipelines. Use when you need to automate quality gates, configure test runners in CI, or establish deployment strategies.
why_zh: 它不生成模板，而是理解你的仓库结构，动态调整每一步，连失败重试和缓存策略都替你想到。
why_en: It reads your repo, not just templates—dynamically rewires steps, retries, and caches so the pipeline fits your code, not the.
